neighbours.label: ' with' in the additive connective 'along with' (adding a further item to a clause)
fire: The company announced layoffs, along with a plan to close two factories.
Police recovered the stolen car, along with several bags of tools.
The recipe uses fresh basil, along with garlic and a little lemon.
Officials released the budget, along with a report on last year's spending.
The museum received the painting, along with letters written by the artist.
Our team will test the software, along with the new hardware drivers.
Rain is expected on Sunday, along with strong winds near the coast.
The senator proposed tax cuts, along with limits on new borrowing.
quiet: The company announced layoffs and a plan to close two factories.
Police recovered the stolen car with help from a local farmer.
The recipe uses fresh basil and garlic and a little lemon.
Officials released the budget with a short press statement.
The museum received the painting from a private collector in Ohio.
Our team will test the software with a group of student volunteers.
Rain is expected on Sunday and strong winds near the coast.
The senator proposed tax cuts and limits on new borrowing.
